account-locked: Account awa temporarily locked tukuyañ ukaru too many jani phuqhata login yantʼawinaka. Please try again later.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel ukax SuperAdmin ukatakikiw, Cloud Panel Dominio ukana.
cloud-settings-desc: WeKan Weddy ukan utjipanxa, Cloud Panel ukax walja WeKan dominionak mä servidorat luqtaraki, sapakis pachpa datonakanïtap. Cloud Panel Dominio ukanxa, SuperAdmin ukaw dominionak CloudFlare ukamp apnaqaraki.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: CloudFlare API llawimpixa, CloudFlare cuentaman zonap utjki uka dominiox proxy DNS qillqatampi CloudFlare Origin certificadompi katuqi. Yaqha dominionakax Let's Encrypt certificado katuqapxi. Llawix servidoran imatawa, janiw mayamp uñachayatäkiti.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Janiw kuna CloudFlare API llawis imatäkiti: sapa dominiox Let's Encrypt certificado katuqi.
error-ldap-login: An pantja occurred while trying ukaru login
error-notAuthorized: You apxi jani authorized ukaru uñjaña aka page.
